notes.title: Have You Played The Turing Test?
notes.content:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day, perhaps for all time.

The Turing Test is an experiment where you determine if an AI can pass itself off as human. You get a person to talk to computers and humans, over text, and see if they can determine which is which. The idea is interesting, but flawed.

The Turing Test is also a first-person puzzler made by Bulkhead Interactive, and it is the same.

notes.title: Wot I Think: The Turing Test
notes.content:
Oh my goodness, if The Turing Test [official site] could have existed in a world that had never seen Portal nor The Talos Principle, it would be lauded, famous beyond belief. Then again, in a world without Portal and The Talos Principle, Bulkhead Interactive would never have made The Turing Test, so it s a little academic. As it is, we ve got here an often smart, never quite brilliant first-person puzzle game that neatly fits into the same category. Here’s wot I think:

notes.title: Update 1.2 notes
notes.content:
[img=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/499520/ss_d508d3e8851c37b041dffc06c4aa5df514ab8cb6.jpg?t=1472726049] [/img]

Hi all, 

The team have once again been working hard to resolve a major issue some of you were experiencing. Please see the notes from the develoepers below for more information:
[list]
[*][i]AMD CPU issue fix has been implemented, which appears to fix the problem on our end. However, we'd appriciate if you let us know if you are still experiencing issues after this update.
[*][i]Console has been implemented that allows unlocking of fps. Please use the tilde key to access. You will need to turn VSYNC off and then use t.maxfps 120 to set the max to 120.
[*][b][i]NOTE: UE4 has a max FPS cap of 120 in the engine, so you can't get higher. We are investigating a way to unlock this.
[/i][/b]
[/list]

Again we'd like to thank you for being patient and the continued support of The Turing Test!


-Amy

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - The Turing Test
notes.content:
The Turing Test is Now Available on Steam!

The Turing Test is a challenging first-person puzzle game set on Jupiter’s moon, Europa. You are Ava Turing, an engineer for the International Space Agency (ISA) sent to discover the cause behind the disappearance of the ground crew stationed there.

notes.title: The Turing Test Now Available For Closer Examination
notes.content:
We are all familiar with the Turing Test, in which a computer and a man must engage in a freestyle rap battle to determine which one is thinking . But there s also a videogame of the same name, which is out today. The Turing Test [official site] is a first-person puzzler set in a research base on Europa, in which you play astronaut Eva Turing as she tries to find out where everyone has gone. It s part of Squeenix s indie claw machine, the Square Enix Collective, and it looks like this.

notes.title: The Turing Test has now officially launched!
notes.content:
The Turing Test has now been released into the wild for you lovely folk! 

I’d like to say a huge thank you on behalf of everyone on the development team and publishing side for the overwhelming support on the lead up to release, and we hope you enjoy our game! 

We’d love to hear your thoughts on the game so please feel free to leave us comments, share any screenshots (remember your spoiler warnings), keep those let’s play videos coming and make use of the forums to help each other solve some of the harder puzzles of course. 

Thanks for playing and good luck out there engineers :) 

-Amy

notes.title: The Turing Test Gets Release Date, Asks Big Questions
notes.content:
It’s hard not to watch the latest trailer for The Turing Test [official site] and see all the stark parallels between Portal and The Talos Principle. A science fiction first-person game where a robot sidekick guides you through various chambers full of puzzles with themes of transhumanism? Still, despite those on-the-sleeve inspirations, I can’t help but feel drawn in by The Turing Test’s atmosphere and heavy philosophical rumblings. And late last week, a new release trailer revealed that we won’t have to wait too much longer, as The Turing Test is due out on August 30.
